title: react-bio-viz
description: React components for biological data (alignment, tree, matrix, genome browser); its PhyloTree is a controlled SVG tree with node and branch click callbacks, per-node styles, collapse, reroot, midpoint root, ladderize and a scale bar.

applied: branch colour: the library draws branches in currentColor; --foreground on the wrapper is set to the GBIF --fg2 token (--fg3 in dark), through the CSS custom property the stylesheet reads (CSS variables)
branch opacity 0.9 (presentation attribute) overridden to 1 with a CSS rule on `.rbv svg path` (CSS override of a library default)
branch width 1.25 via the branchWidth prop (global, one value for every branch)

tip labels: Rubik (--font-body) and italic for scientific names, label colour --fg1, through the leafTextComponent slot (SVG <text> we render ourselves; the library's default slot is hardcoded sans-serif)
tip markers: one colour for all tips from the --fg3 token (leafMarkerColor prop); radius via nodeRadius, auto-scaled to row density (global value)

highlight: tip marker and label in --color-primary and bold via nodeStyles; halo behind highlighted labels (paint-order stroke in --color-primary-light) from our slot; optional library search dims all other tips (searchQuery regex)

clade colours from the categorical palette (--purple-100, --periwinkle-100, --fuchsia-100, --peach-100, --lightblue-100) through nodeStyles/branchStyles keyed by node id (colours branch, marker and, for collapsed clades, the triangle)

hover and selection accent: the library reads the --rbv-accent CSS variable (hover stroke on markers, branch hover, active node); set to --color-primary (measured: hover marker stroke rgb(76,155,69) = the token)

dark theme: .dark class and shadcn CSS variables (--background, --foreground, --primary, --border, ...) set on the wrapper from gbifDarkTheme(); branches, markers and the toolbar follow, labels use our slot colour

toolbar (PhyloTree) buttons themed through the shadcn variables (--primary, --secondary, --accent, --border, --ring, --radius) set from GBIF tokens; this is the library's own chrome, restyled by variables only
scale bar, support labels and collapsed-clade labels: font forced to --font-body with `font-family: ... !important` CSS (they are inline sans-serif in the library)
column canvas (own, not a library feature): bar colour from --periwinkle-100, text in --fg1/--font-body, header strip in --font-body
runner tokens (background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily) map onto --background, --gv-label, --foreground, --rbv-accent and the font variable
not_possible: per-branch or per-clade branch width (branchWidth is one global number; branchStyles only has colour)
node shapes: markers are circles only; one radius for all nodes (internal markers get radius+0.5); no per-node size, and nodeRadius 0 hides tip markers but leaves internal markers
internal-node marker fill is hardcoded `var(--background, white)` and the stroke currentColor: no way to colour internal markers except through the clade nodeStyles colour of the branch
selection halo for several nodes: only one `activeNodeId` (enlarged marker with accent stroke); multi-tip highlight is our own label halo and marker colour
tooltip chrome: tips carry a native <title> tooltip (browser chrome, unstyleable); the library has no tooltip component for tree nodes, the harness tooltip is the shell's
label font in the default slot (hardcoded sans-serif) and font of support/scale/collapsed labels (inline style): only reachable through our own leafTextComponent or !important CSS
radial labels are truncated to 24 characters before they reach the slot, so the slot cannot show the full name in radial layout

the library registers its own :root variables (--background, --foreground, --primary, --radius, --spacing, --font-sans, Tailwind --color-*, --text-*) in an injected <style id=rbv-styles>; GBIF tokens in unlayered CSS win (measured: --radius-md stays 4px) but the names overlap and the stylesheet cannot be loaded as a file instead of injected
theme prop or dark-mode prop: none; dark mode means setting variables and a .dark class on an ancestor
level of detail: no label or marker hiding at low zoom (an adapter CSS rule hides label text below 8 px rows, labelled partial)
styling.notes: Styling is controlled almost entirely through CSS custom properties (colours, accent, toolbar), one slot (leafTextComponent: label font, colour, links), and global numeric props (branchWidth, nodeRadius, label font size). Everything is SVG so any rule can also be written as CSS targeting classes (.tipnode, .scale-bar, .collapsed-clade) and attributes (data-node-id, data-branch-id). Anything per node beyond colour and bold is impossible without forking. Fonts: the shell loads Rubik from Google Fonts; the sandbox blocks it, so screenshots show the fallback.
